titles.title: 764b88ed — a BUILD record stores the label, anchor and kind it was filed under
764b88ed — a TESTS record stores the label, anchor and kind it was filed under
764b88ed — a code-review record stores the label, anchor and kind it was filed under
persistBuildRecord writes a fresh standalone:false record at buildArtifactPaths when none exists
a second validate UNIONS tasks by id, preserves createdAt, refreshes updatedAt (one record, not N)
re-validating the same task refreshes its passed without duplicating the row
an existing meta.approvedAt (+ reviewOverride) is PRESERVED across an upsert (never un-complete a story)
a malformed prior record is treated as absent (fail-open fresh write), not a throw
persistStandaloneBuildRecord writes standalone:true json + the SAME md via the thin wrapper (byte-identical)
approveWorkflowTarget completes the persisted plan-driven BUILD record (keys on the BUILD- prefix)
S002 regression: a Trivial-standalone re-run with a fresh createdAt keeps the SAME md folder (folder anchored on the PRESERVED createdAt, so BUILD + CR never split)
a prior-only meta field SURVIVES a later write that omits it (sizeClass + triageRationale were silently deleted)
the new write still WINS on a meta field it DOES supply (preservation must not become prior-always-wins)
t9: a write that OMITS standalone keeps the prior true (the carry-forward the shared validate persist now relies on)
the PRIOR-wins exceptions are untouched: createdAt and all four completion/rejection stamps still beat the new write
BYTE-IDENTITY: a new write that supplies every field the record already carried produces the SAME json and md as a fresh write
a meta field can no longer be cleared by OMITTING it — the documented trade-off, pinned so it is a decision and not a surprise
BYTE-IDENTITY golden 1: a real pre-fix well-formed standalone record renders exactly its captured markdown
BYTE-IDENTITY golden 2: a real pre-fix plan-driven record renders exactly its captured markdown
BYTE-IDENTITY golden 3 (PATHOLOGICAL): REPAIRED at t8 — every defect t2 catalogued is gone, and nothing else moved
FORWARD COMPAT: a record written entirely before this Story still parses, merges via mergeWithPrior and renders without error
t7 WRITE SIDE: body.commit is populated from HEAD on BOTH routes, identically
t7 WRITE SIDE: body.commit is OMITTED — not empty-stringed — when HEAD cannot be read
t7 WRITE SIDE: an explicitly SUPPLIED commit wins for that write; a later persist REFRESHES to HEAD (the specified "at persist time" semantics)
t7 RENDER (PLAN-DRIVEN only): body.commit renders as `**Commit:**` and body.summary as `## Summary`
t7 RENDER: an absent commit/summary renders NEITHER section (omit-slots intact)
t7: the three hand-filled records prove the gap was real — and are now what the producer writes automatically
t8: the TWO unconditional parts always render, even on a record carrying nothing else
t8: each of the SEVEN omit-slots renders when populated — one assertion per section
t8: each of the SEVEN omit-slots is ABSENT when its content is — one assertion per section
t8: the title derives from meta.sizeClass, NOT meta.standalone — the FLIPPED state still renders a standalone title
t8: a record carrying BOTH focus and tasks renders BOTH sections — neither route's content is lost
t8: STANDALONE-route rendering of body.summary and body.commit now works — the half deferred from t7
t8: an empty or absent changeLog still renders NO `## Changes` section
t8: renderStandaloneBuildRecordMd still exports and DELEGATES — identical output, not a second implementation
t8: NO code path selects a renderer on meta.standalone — the same record renders the same regardless of the flag, except for its honest "Standalone:" bit
t4 — a record carrying standalone true is placed under docs/standalone
t4 — CARRY-FORWARD: a prior true survives a later write that OMITS the flag, and the markdown does not move
t4 — an omitted flag on a FIRST write still reads as epic, so nothing is manufactured
t5 — a standalone record renders the standalone heading and "Standalone: yes", not the plan-driven title
t5 — the render keys on sizeClass, so it survives a record whose flag is absent
43d72766 — persistBuildRecord files an UNFLAGGED record beside its standalone story, not under docs/epics/
43d72766 — an epic-parented record is still filed under docs/epics/ (the story says nothing, so nothing widens)
a build record with testRecord renders a line that links to TESTS.md, carries it forward when a later write omits it, and without it renders byte for byte as before
with a test record on disk and no build record, a first build record written by each of its three writers takes the test record's createdAt and lands in its folder
the first write creates the record with one Task; a second Task is added; writing the first Task again replaces its entry only and keeps createdAt

the json is TESTS-<epicHash>-<storyId>.json and the document is TESTS.md in the same folder as the Story's BUILD.md, for an Epic's Story and for a standalone one (mutation: derive the folder from the record's own time)
the document shows totals, then per Task and per named test a table of result, title and file, the tests reported by the builder with their evidence, and the failures outside the named cases
the stored mapping of a Task is read back as the mapping that was supplied, and an unreadable or misshapen record reads as no stored mapping
when the document cannot be written after the json was, the json is put back: a first write leaves no record, a later one leaves the earlier run
text that came from the builder is rendered on one line, so it cannot add lines that read as the record's own; and an unreadable record is told from an absent one
